name: Adam Smasher
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures
- Custom animations
- Custom VFX
- Custom SFX
- Custom Voice-over for all languages, full of swear words.

- Custom loading screen and in-game icons
- Up to 96% chrome



*"You look like a cut of fuckable meat. Are you?"*


Adam Smasher, another one of Night City's grim legends, turned out to be true, after all. With a body made almost entirely out of chrome, he is ready to punch, shoot and explode his way through the Rift, all on Arasaka's orders.

Features a new model, a complete animation overhaul, where you switch between melee fist fighting and ranged wrist-gun fighting, a VFX overhaul, a boat load of new SFX, a whole intimidating voice-over, and of course new icons/loading screen splash. Enjoy!
Works on ALL SKINS, except for Arcane Survivor. Picking any other skins will result in Adam Smasher still being in the game.
